name: recovery-una-robots
title: Page not found at /robots.txt
text:
Page not found at /robots.txt Page not found (404) Request Method: GET Request URL: https://bibliotheque.una.edu.ci/robots.txt Using the URLconf defined in bibliouna.urls ,
      Django tried these URL patterns, in this order: administration/ galerie/ actualite/ abonne/ publication/ [name='index'] contact/
                [name='contact'] presentation/
                [name='presentation'] charte_bon_usage/
                [name='charte_bon_usage'] reglement_interieur/
                [name='reglement_interieur'] parametre/ admin/ ^media/(?P<path>.*)$ ^static/(?P<path>.*)$ The current path, robots.txt ,
        
        didn’t match any of these. You’re seeing this error because you have DEBUG = True in
      your Django settings file. Change that to False , and Django
      will display a standard 404 page.
